mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.ticket_subtotal_amount), 0) AS gross_ticket_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(p.booking_fee_amount), 0) AS booking_fee_gross_amount FROM ticket_payments p JOIN ticket_orders o ON o.id = p.ticket_order_id WHERE p.status = 'DONE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_order_items oi JOIN ticket_products tp ON tp.id = oi.ticket_product_id WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = o.id AND tp.expo_id = #{expoId} )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_ticket_amount), 0) AS ticket_refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_booking_fee_amount), 0) AS booking_fee_refund_amount FROM ticket_refunds r JOIN ticket_orders o ON o.id = r.ticket_order_id WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_order_items oi JOIN ticket_products tp ON tp.id = oi.ticket_product_id WHERE oi.ticket_order_id = o.id AND tp.expo_id = #{expoId} )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bp.approved_amount), 0) FROM booth_payments bp WHERE bp.status = 'DONE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM booth_allocations ba JOIN expo_companies ec ON ec.booth_allocation_id = ba.id WHERE ba.booth_order_id = bp.booth_order_id AND ec.expo_id = #{expoId} )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) FROM settlement_adjustments a WHERE a.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND a.status = 'APPROVED'
